connects.note: Topic: AI capabilities. Also present: Tirath Trivedi. The meeting showcased AI solutions for engineering requirements, safety and FMEA documentation, compliance, physical AI, and embedded vision, with Amod, Luca, Erik, Mannepalli, Bharath, Vishal, and Kuntal demonstrating locally hosted or deployable tools that reduce manual effort while retaining human approval. Tirath highlighted the value of reusable frameworks and productization but noted challenges around data quality, model accuracy, hardware integration, security, and the 6–12 month maturation effort; the group agreed to arrange follow-up sessions, including a scrubbed safety-tool demo, embedded-AI discussions, and a CRA cybersecurity review.
